entities.summary: John Kinnamos or Joannes Kinnamos or John Cinnamus, was a Byzantine historian. He was imperial secretary to Emperor Manuel I (1143–1180), whom he accompanied on his campaigns in Europe and Asia Minor. It appears that Kinnamos outlived Andronikos I, who died in 1185.
